selectedIdea.angle: Show what the evidence says about dart.

synthesis.factHandoff: The DART experiment attributed the shorter orbital period of Dimorphos around Didymos to the spacecraft impact. In the initial report the period dropped from 11h55 to 11h23.

narrative.content:
Kern van het verhaal
Door de inslag werd de omlooptijd van Dimorphos ongeveer een halfuur korter.

Redactionele insteek
Licht dit feit in gewone taal toe.

source: the spacecraft’s impact altered Dimorphos’ orbit around Didymos by 32 minutes, shortening the 11 hour and 55-minute orbit to 11 hours and 23 minutes.
